title: Powerful New Capabilities Now Generally Available
summary: We are excited to announce the full launch of our advanced new capabilities, now out of beta and ready to empower your workflows with enhanced performance and reliability.

title: Advanced File Management & Display
summary: Take full command of your content with our new features, allowing you to easily upload, remove, download, and customize how all your files appear directly within the editor.

title: Noeko's Live Product Roadmap
summary: Discover our exciting new public roadmap, providing a transparent look at our product's journey, from recent achievements to upcoming innovations.

title: Enhanced Checkbox Experience
summary: Enjoy a significantly improved editing experience with bigger, easier-to-click, visually updated, and fully draggable checkboxes.

title: Enhanced Real-time Collaboration
summary: Experience the upgraded editor designed for seamless real-time collaboration, making it easier and more intuitive to work together than ever before.

title: Seamless Collaboration and Discovery
summary: Enjoy a more seamless collaborative experience as you effortlessly share and discover relevant items with your network, enhancing teamwork and productivity.

title: Unlocking Noeko: Our Open Source Commitment
summary: We are thrilled to open-source Noeko's codebase, empowering our community with unprecedented control, direct involvement, and full transparency into its exciting future.

title: Global Language Support
summary: Experience Noeko in your preferred language as we introduce comprehensive support for a wide array of international languages, making our platform truly global.

title: Transform Your Workspace with New & Improved Themes
summary: Immerse yourself in a refreshed visual experience as we roll out stunning new themes and significantly enhance our existing collection for a truly personalized look.

title: Unlock Your Knowledge with Enhanced Graph View
summary: Discover deeper connections and streamline your workflow with an enhanced Graph View featuring powerful filtering by tags, time, and shared items.

title: Precision Search & Curated Collections
summary: Effortlessly pinpoint information with advanced filtering and sorting options, then save your refined searches as personalized collections for instant access and deeper insights.

title: Dynamic Content Views
summary: Explore new flexible display modes to effortlessly visualize and interact with your linked content, making your notes more dynamic and organized.

title: Noeko Self-Hosting and Premium Plans
summary: Prepare for Noeko's highly anticipated public release, featuring robust self-hosting options and flexible paid plans tailored to your needs.

title: Precision in Your Daily Greetings
summary: We are enhancing our time-based greetings to ensure they always perfectly align with your current local time, improving your daily experience.

title: Streamlined Tag Actions
summary: Gain instant control over your tagged content with new in-list actions, allowing you to quickly unapply tags, delete items, or view details without navigating away.

title: Universal Content Import
summary: Seamlessly bring in and interact with all your essential content, from web pages to videos and text documents, to centralize your knowledge.
